cases.title: Template library empty state renders; New template opens modal; Cancel closes without saving
Create template: merge-field insert, save -> row in list and in DB with subject/body/category/shared
Validation: saving a template with empty name shows a server error inside the modal (no crash)
Preview renders with sample values; Edit updates DB; category filter + search narrow the list
Agent sees shared template but only the owner can edit/delete (no edit buttons for agent; API refuses)
Delete: dismissing confirm keeps it; accepting removes row and DB record
Automation empty state; Create rule modal validation (required fields) keeps modal open
Create Send-AI-Template rule: row appears; DB has trigger/action/template/delay and is active
Create "Pause this contact" rule (PAUSE_PROSPECT, replaced "Pause Campaign"): option offered, no template picker, row listed, DB row persisted
Toggle rule off/on (the repaired PUT): DB is_active flips and UI reflects it
Search filters rules; delete (confirm) removes row and DB record
AI generator: Classify disabled until designation entered; classification shows persona + confidence
Sequence tab: 3-email sequence is generated, shows compliance check, copy button works
Classification failure (500) shows an error message to the user
